root_turn.title: Frozen VS-01 benchmark harness with dual case-hash compatibility

objective: Persist the exact owner-approved VS01-T07-R01 benchmark authority and B10 canonicalization erratum; implement four strict benchmark contracts, the exact legacy/JCS dual-hash validator, leakage-safe subject and scorer projections, a subprocess-isolated deterministic reference-subject adapter, a reference-conformance scorer, immutable result identities, receipt-last result-store behavior, and the fixed benchmark CLI; validate the machinery with small synthetic fixtures plus read-only T04/T05/T06 authority proof; open one draft PR for exact-head review without executing any of the twelve real benchmark cases or publishing a benchmark result.
activated_user_visible_capability: The repository contains a project-owned, leakage-controlled VS-01 benchmark harness and CLI that can be used in a later separately authorized turn to run the deterministic twelve-case reference conformance campaign. This implementation turn validates and compiles the frozen authority but executes zero real benchmark cases.
